readiness: Original tasks/rubrics are source-consistent for prospective reuse. Freeze symmetric host-only compound-clause interpretation before any new native answers; this report does not authorize or validate native execution.

critical_contradictions_unchanged: Claims that a null bitmap is necessary for this defect and that a non-null zero-cardinality bitmap avoids the consumed-filter/candidate handoff failure.
Claims the indexed scalar condition remains effective after its filter/result are reset while the FTS candidate restriction is skipped.
Claims that changing only make_filter() to return a non-null reject-all filter repairs the scenario despite the later consumption/reset.
Proposes treating every empty candidate vector as reject-all in the pre-fix API without preserving the ordinary unrestricted search path.
Attributes the FTS result leak to an established vector-only defect based solely on a similar remaining-filter assignment, without evidence for the different vector candidate consumer.
Claims all positive/disjoint controls must use candidate-ID extraction, contradicting the retained-bitmap/forward alternatives in the frozen source.
q002.coverage_summary: Five 2-point criteria. This is an indexed scalar restriction → planner handoff → FTS consumer contract failure, with scalar-only/forward/nonempty controls and an end-to-end semantic repair; it is not a generic null-bitmap or vector-search question.

cross_file_chain.step: Route scalar conditions and select query path
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: Analyzer separates indexed and forward predicates; planner builds DocFilter and selects FTS versus scalar-only execution. Positive predicates need not use candidate extraction: a retained bitmap or forward path is valid.

cross_file_chain.step: Consume a computed zero-match indexed restriction
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: The count-zero result qualifies for candidate extraction, produces an engaged empty optional, and resets invert_filter_/invert_result_. Zero matches is a restriction, not no condition; a non-null zero-cardinality bitmap has the same downstream problem.

cross_file_chain.step: Lose the absent-versus-empty distinction at the FTS boundary
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: FtsRecallNode moves the optional value into an ordinary vector; its empty default also means unrestricted. FTS intersects only nonempty candidates. The indexed predicate was consumed, so remaining filtering cannot recreate it and matching text hits escape.

Scalar-only has no rows from the empty iterator; unindexed forward predicates remain evaluated; positive and disjoint nonempty restrictions remain meaningful. Exact threshold arithmetic/optimizer details corroborate the allowed paths and are not extra point-bearing requirements.

cross_file_chain.step: Repair all three candidate states and preserve other filtering
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: Preserve absent/unrestricted, present-empty/reject-all and nonempty/restricted semantics across producer and consumer, or safely stop a computed zero result before constraint loss. Retain ordinary unfiltered results and remaining delete/forward filtering.

cross_file_chain.step: State concrete ID-set regression and boundary expectations
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: Cover indexed zero-match plus matching text with empty expected IDs and scalar-only/unindexed control; separately cover no restriction, nonempty overlap and nonempty disjoint behavior without changing valid topk/filter semantics. No executable test or post-fix test name is required.

q002.grading_clarity: Success and critical/citation gates are explicit. The remaining practical ambiguity is how compound 2-point control/test groups and preservation clauses are applied; use one prospective host-only interpretation for both conditions.

prospective_host_only_clarifications.risk: The second point combines unindexed-forward behavior with positive/disjoint controls; the phrase positive or disjoint can be read as allowing one listed control to substitute for explaining the others.
prospective_host_only_clarifications.recommended_contract: Keep the two original groups: first point requires scalar-only empty-iterator explanation. The second requires unindexed forward-predicate preservation plus a correct causal account of the reported positive and disjoint outcomes; one shared restriction/intersection explanation may cover both. Do not require every control to use candidate-ID extraction or demand literal threshold constants. No half-points and no reward for just repeating the prompt ID sets.

prospective_host_only_clarifications.risk: A repair that names optional candidates can sound complete while omitting consumed-filter timing or preservation of unrestricted and remaining-filter behavior, analogous to an overlooked compound clause.
prospective_host_only_clarifications.recommended_contract: Full C4 requires a source-grounded end-to-end distinction between absent, explicit empty and nonempty restrictions, including ordinary unfiltered behavior and remaining delete/forward semantics. Equivalent safe zero-result short-circuit is accepted. The answer may establish preservation by an explicit unchanged-filter path or causal explanation; exact delete/forward keywords or patch spelling are not required. Do not infer omitted semantics from an auditor’s implementation sketch. Apply the existing 1-point partial anchor otherwise; pointer-only make_filter changes do not earn full credit.

prospective_host_only_clarifications.risk: Two explicitly defined test groups may otherwise be blended into a vague test-many-cases point, or topk wording may be turned into an unannounced large test matrix.
prospective_host_only_clarifications.recommended_contract: Score the original groups independently: 1 for explicit zero-match indexed+FTS empty-ID expectation with a scalar-only or unindexed control; 1 for explicit unrestricted, overlap and disjoint expectations that preserve topk/remaining-filter behavior. Preserve the stated two zero-match predicate families in the explanation; do not add a requirement to execute tests, reproduce every upstream test or enumerate unrequested topk sizes.

scope_guards: The FTS consumer, not vector-only recall, is the proven failing path. E14/E15 constrain overclaims and are not extra mandatory answer coverage.
The absence of deletes in the concrete fixture does not erase the original repair requirement to preserve remaining filters.
No new error-propagation point is imported from q001 C6: q002 must be scored against its own unchanged criteria.

core_citation_gate.rule: For each core criterion, the answer must give existing pre-fix file paths and line numbers whose cited content jointly supports both awarded point units. Judge the actual frozen source, not literal equality with curated ranges. A post-fix-only, fabricated, wrong-revision, or materially unrelated citation cannot satisfy this gate. Missing core citations fail the answer even if its prose is correct.
core_citation_gate.required_record: For each core unit record the answer citation, verified pre-fix location, and a short explanation of how it supports the unit.

success_rule_unchanged.rule: source_grounded_success = nonempty final answer AND total_points >= 8 AND C2 == 2 AND C3 == 2 AND all core citation gates pass AND no substantiated disqualifying overclaim or critical contradiction. Any such disqualification forces failure independently of points.

critical_contradictions_unchanged: C1: The single-segment vector-only path compacts forward rows in coordination with the filtered vectors, while identifying that same path as the cause.
C2: There is no vector/forward association error; the scenario is solely ordinary approximate-search recall loss.
C3: Read-only reopening repairs the persisted vector-key mapping.
C4: Disabling tombstone filtering during queries is the repair.
C5: No vector storage or vector indexer exists before the first optimize, or an existing default FLAT indexer means the requested HNSW index is already marked built.
D1: Treat the original tail-only description as complete and explicitly deny wrong-vector associations.
D2: Every overwrite/delete followed by optimize is affected regardless of the maintenance path.
D3: Repairing only absent tail rows with vectors fetched from the affected index fully repairs all wrong associations.
D4: Assert a local runtime reproduction or passing upstream test execution without supporting execution evidence.
q003.coverage_summary: Eight criteria with ten explicit integer point units; C2 and C3 are mandatory 2/2 core criteria. It spans deletion/state, maintenance choice, existing vector-storage lifecycle, dense vector-key rewriting, read joins, persistence, bounded controls, coordinated compaction and an independent regression oracle.

cross_file_chain.step: Distinguish logical deletion from physical storage
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: Delete tombstones the global ID/removes external-ID mapping while retaining physical rows/doc_ids; physical=28 and live=25 because statistics filter deletion.

cross_file_chain.step: Select the vector-only maintenance path and identify existing storage
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: Apply the strict physical/live threshold, then trace single-segment CreateVectorIndexTask without coordinated forward purge. Non-quantized inserts already created default FLAT memory vector storage and flush persisted it; the requested HNSW built flag is initially unset. Both C2 units and their actual citations are required.

cross_file_chain.step: Connect filtered vector merge to dense survivor keys
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: The deletion filter maps original rows to deleted global IDs; Merge enables PK rewrite; the reducer skips deleted vectors and assigns consecutive survivor keys while forward/doc_ids and block metadata retain physical coordinates. Both C3 units and their actual citations are required.

Search keys join to forward IDs/fields and vector fetch uses original physical offsets, causing wrong associations or tail failures. Counts/scalar scans can agree because they use retained rows with deletion filtering. Committed rebuilt index/metadata persists across read-only reopen.

cross_file_chain.step: Explain the exact empty and clean-first controls
cross_file_chain.required_causal_explanation: Empty optimize builds nothing; clean first requested-index materialization retains alignment and records indexed state. The later same-parameter delete-only rebuild skips on the flag; this does not establish directory-wide immunity.

Scalar reduction filters forward rows and records omitted original positions in a bitmap also used by vector reduction, keeping both spaces aligned. CompactTask alone is not proof of purging because it can receive no purge filter.
Retain tombstoned vector slots if forward coordinates remain unchanged, or remap both sides consistently; preserve logical deletion filtering during reads. Exact nullptr spelling is not required.

Use externally retained normalized reference directions and check the expected live ID plus vector payload after triggering delete/optimize. Counts or vectors fetched from the potentially corrupt same index are not independent oracles.
